title: RedactedPayload
description: Sanitized DOM + redacted screenshot + privacy stats. Output of the Privacy Engine (R3). Consumed by server planner (R5). The redaction map is NOT included — it stays on the client.

sanitized_dom.description: DOM snapshot with all PII replaced by indexed tokens like [EMAIL_1], [NAME_1], [AADHAAR_1]

elements_count.description: Number of interactive elements in the snapshot

text.description: Text content with PII replaced by tokens: [EMAIL_1], [NAME_1], etc.

type.description: Input type attribute (text, password, email, etc.)

coordinates.description: Bounding box [x, y, width, height] in viewport pixels

forms.description: Forms detected on the page with field structure (values redacted)

inputs.description: List of input field names/types in the form

vault_available.description: Which form fields can be filled from the vault

redacted_screenshot.description: Base64-encoded JPEG with faces blacked out and PII text regions blacked out. Null if no screenshot was provided.

faces_redacted.description: Number of face regions blacked out in the screenshot

pii_tokens_masked.description: Total PII tokens created across all types (e.g., 5 means [EMAIL_1]..[EMAIL_2], [NAME_1]..[NAME_3])

dom_masked_fields.description: Number of DOM elements that had their text content modified by redaction

ocr_regions_redacted.description: Number of text regions blacked out in the screenshot based on OCR PII detection

pii_breakdown.description: Count of PII items detected per type

detection_methods.description: How many PII items were caught by each detection method

token_manifest.description: Tells the server which redaction tokens exist in this payload (but NOT their real values). The server uses this to understand what data was redacted.

tokens_used.description: List of all tokens used, e.g., ['[EMAIL_1]', '[NAME_1]', '[PAN_1]']
